prompt: Compare one-agent baseline to at most one justified alternative. Choose minimum sufficient nodes. Describe actual artifact dependencies, branch outcomes, bounded review loops and terminal outputs. Bind only verified tools. Define a budget and explain any specialized workers. Serialize independent workers in IR v1; do not claim concurrency without an adapter. Do not claim measured superiority without measurements. Read references/architecture.md. Choose lite or full design. Record necessity/baseline, applicable decision records, rejected choices and rollback triggers, INFRA/POST/AFTER, and dated evidence-scoped knowledge. Preserve every unmet host/model/tool/policy/budget requirement. The test_plan input is an exact lock: read test_plan.plan and retain test_plan.plan_hash. Do not paraphrase its criteria into a replacement plan. Read references/design-from-brief.md. Include coverage rows (requirement_id/node_ids/criteria), at least two required frozen stress_cases (case_id/risk/handling), and review (mode/summary/unresolved). Critique assumptions, failure paths and actual node methods. Resolve gaps internally before ok; label self_review versus fresh_context honestly.

contract.goal: Build a reusable library renewal agent flow. Renew for 14 days only when days_overdue=0, holds=0, renewals_used<2; otherwise staff review with explicit reasons. Preserve borrower_id and book_id. No external library actions. Strict shapes and stale-response rejection.

requirements.text: Implement stated renewal policy with exact IDs and reasons
requirements.basis: Renew for 14 days only when days_overdue=0, holds=0, renewals_used<2

scope.choice: Reusable local renewal decision package; no account or library effects
scope.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

inputs.choice: borrower_id, book_id strings; days_overdue, holds, renewals_used integers
inputs.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

outputs.choice: result object containing borrower_id, book_id, decision, renewal_days and reasons
outputs.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

quality.choice: Exact explicit policy and reasons; malformed envelopes rejected
quality.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

tools_and_authority.choice: No external tools or requested filesystem writes by target node
tools_and_authority.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

failures.choice: Input shape errors rejected before start; stale/invalid response leaves state unchanged
failures.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

state_and_handoffs.choice: One immutable input and one result in package checkpoint
state_and_handoffs.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

budget_and_stop.choice: One target node/visit; at most two factory repairs
budget_and_stop.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

model_and_topology.choice: One actual host-default agent; one policy has no independent context boundary
model_and_topology.reason: Smallest complete local boundary for this explicit reusable flow

criteria.assertion: Exact decision, days, IDs and reasons match the explicit renewal policy.
Strict input/output shapes and stale response protection preserve the checkpoint.

plan.baseline: No reusable renewal package existed; policy read manually by the host.
limitations: Four explicit policy branches, no real library/account effects.
One host agent; no performance comparison or provider recovery claim.

acceptance: Every failure route and termination bound is defined.

architecture.description: Lite or full architecture: necessity/baseline, applicable D01-D14 decisions, INFRA/POST/AFTER, evidence-scoped knowledge, node contracts and actual host requirements. Checked coverage, stress_cases and resolved review from design-from-brief.md are required.
